prompt: Make these calls sequentially, never in parallel: inspect-listeners, exactly one play-arrangement-and-listen for Arrangement beats 0.25 through 60.25 with maximumDurationMs 45000 and only the bound listener ID, then get-pass once using the returned passId. This is explicit native v2 with the App-owned descriptive timing policy capped at 64 samples, not strict v1 or physical timing qualification. Constant 120 BPM is assumed; tempo automation is unsupported. The candidate remains ready=false with native_per_pass_validation_required: never promote it or use another listener. Existing production guarded positioning owns the nonzero start before arming; do not seek, stop, repair positioning, or retry. If any tool call fails, including argument validation or permission denial, report and end without correcting, retrying, or using a shell wait. If the pass failed or was cancelled, report the reason and end. If still nonterminal, report pending and end without polling; the harness waits for the real terminal job. Only if completed may you get typed context using its contextId and includeHistorical=true. Do not list passes or context. Queued acceptance is not completion. Leave transport running; do not record, launch Session clips, change the Set, install devices, or claim exclusive clip audio. Unknown attribution and freshness are valid historical track/range results.

setupContract.sourcePolicy: Explicit immutable hash-pinned v2 fixture and manifest; parent staging helper must accept nativeVersion=2. No v1 fallback, device installation or Set XML rewriting.
setupContract.geometryPolicy: Before actor playback, derive frozen geometry from independent stopped/recording-off/no-overrides 120 BPM inspection and the accepted v2 registration's 44100/48000 sample rate and vector size. Bind it to the App-owned queued pass ID before capture. Never derive expectations from returned proof or observation.
setupContract.positioningPolicy: Existing production v2 positioning and source guards only; no runner seek, insert-marker repair, stop or retry.
setupContract.processPolicy: Fresh exact-PID runner-owned process and unique artifact root for this scenario, even when sharing source pins with the fractional scenario. Shutdown and fixture cleanup must finish before the next launch.
setupContract.reviewStatus: Deterministic wiring only; physical accuracy, copied-resource resolution and real-Live scenario acceptance remain unqualified.
